channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire
channel.description: AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: AI-Powered Hackers Target Japanese Companies With Automated Attacks and Credential Theft
item.description: GBHackers: An investigation of three exposed attack infrastructures shows attackers using AI to automate intrusions and build credential-theft tools against Japanese firms.

item.title: Anthropic's Unreleased AI Model Chains Flaws Into Working Chrome, Safari, Windows and Linux Exploits
item.description: The Hacker News: Anthropic says an unreleased model chained flaws into working proof-of-concept exploits for major browsers and OSes in lab tests, not in real attacks.

item.title: Malware Yoba: Ciberdelincuentes usan binarios de ChatGPT y Claude para atacar usuarios de IA
item.description: portalgeek.co: Yoba malware is spread to AI users through fake ChatGPT and Claude desktop binaries.

item.title: 脸都被“偷”走！澳洲华女被诈骗4.9万澳元！
item.description: yeeyi: An Australian woman of Chinese background lost A$49,000 to a scam, and her face was then used in an AI scam ad.

item.title: 男子用AI诈骗好友170多万 信任危机引反思
item.description: 中华网: A man used AI-generated video to defraud friends of over 1.7 million yuan.

item.title: 男子用AI生成视频诈骗好友170万元炒股全赔光

item.title: Parents sue OpenAI, allege ChatGPT encouraged daughter to stop epilepsy medication
